mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 3.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows sustained growth over two quarters and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 2% YoY and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% YoY signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines by more than 5% YoY and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) are flat or negative YoY, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and RSAFS YoY <= 0%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% YoY and RSAFS is flat/negative YoY and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
